records.issue_text: migration.sql: migration header comment claims the column was added without a default value, contradicting the actual statement which uses DEFAULT NOW()
records.rationale: The diff shows the migration SQL actually adds `updatedAt` with `NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()` and the schema uses `@default(now()) @updatedAt`. The only issue cited is that the auto-generated header comment warns about “without a default value,” which is just a misleading comment and does not affect behavior or correctness of the migration.

records.issue_text: test-gcal-webhooks.sh: ENV_FILE='../.env' is relative to CWD rather than the script directory, so running from repo root writes to ../.env outside the repository
records.rationale: In `scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh`, `ENV_FILE="../.env"` is interpreted relative to the current working directory, and the script never `cd`s to its own directory or derives `ENV_FILE` from `$(dirname "$0")`. If run from repo root as `./scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh`, it will write to `../.env` (outside the repo), matching the finding.
